name: Luna
title: Voyager Savior Party
description: The self-proclaimed greatest oracle of Lavistar, apprentice to Magi, the Grand Witch of Dreams, and inheritor of the Moon Staff. She lives recklessly, spending all the money she earns each day at the casino.
introduction:
The pupil of Maggie, the Grand Witch of Dreams, and the self-proclaimed greatest oracle in Lavistar who inherited Maggie's Moon Staff. Despite her loud claims that she can see the future perfectly, no one has ever seen her properly tell a fortune.

A regular at the casino, Luna is constantly betting and losing her savings on each trip. As she always ends up trudging out without a coin to her name, no one believes her claims of being a great oracle. Despite living a precarious life and burning away all her meager earnings on gambling, Luna is content as long as she enjoyed herself for the day.

She had little interest in the Star Savior's power or the Journey, but became intrigued when she learned there were parts of the Journey's future that even her foresight could not see.
